svg.title: Self-hosted server-side GTM on Cloud Run: estimated monthly server cost
svg.desc: Bar chart based on Google's estimate of about 45 US dollars per tagging server per month on Cloud Run. One server: about 45 dollars, not recommended for production. Two servers, Google's recommended minimum: about 90 dollars. Ten servers, the top of Google's example autoscaling range: about 450 dollars. Google says 2 to 10 servers handle roughly 35 to 350 requests per second. Logging, load balancers and network traffic are extra.
svg.text: Cloud Run: what the servers alone cost per month
Based on Google's estimate of ~$45 per tagging server per month (1 vCPU, 0.5 GB, CPU always allocated).
Google expects 2–10 servers to handle about 35–350 requests per second. Not included: logging, load balancer, network, preview server.
Source: Google, "Cloud Run setup guide" for server-side tagging, as of October 2026. Estimates in USD; your bill depends on traffic and settings.
